shared_elements: animal in low relief on a rectangular stone panel
register or band of repeated motifs along the top edge
raised arm/limb of a creature crossing the field
justification: Both surfaces show animal figures in low relief, including a prominent beaked/bird-like head in profile, and both have a band of repeated motifs running along the upper edge. But A is a multi-register array of small schematic creatures (fox-like animals, birds, a snake, boxy repeated forms) stacked in tiers, while B is a single large, anatomically elaborated winged hybrid with rendered feathers, curled mane and a raised arm filling the whole field — the composition, scale relations and rendering conventions are quite different.
